dialogue.vk001_01_velvet_job: Heartbreaker Protocol. The Claws changed it, started selling copies. I need the prototype and its signing key back. Get those out and I'll make you a clean build.
dialogue.vk001_01_v_hack: Heartbreaker. What does it actually do?
dialogue.vk001_01_velvet_hack: Mine interrupts a conditioning signal. Gives someone a few seconds with their own head clear. Theirs holds them in the loop. They took the cutoff out.
dialogue.vk001_01_velvet_recover: The signing key's on it. I need that to revoke their batch. Copy the code and key first. Then we can shut it down.
dialogue.vk001_01_v_name: Do you always flirt when you need something fixed?
dialogue.vk001_01_v_accept: I'll get it. Show me where.
dialogue.vk001_01_velvet_route: Three Claws watching the place. Two access points. First one has the prototype and key. Second one distributes their build. Keep both intact.
dialogue.vk001_01_velvet_bows: You'll see little black bows in the interface. Those were there before the Claws got involved.
dialogue.vk001_01_v_later: Got something else to finish. I'll come back.
dialogue.vk001_01_velvet_later: All right. I'll keep watching the relay.
dialogue.vk001_02_velvet_arrive: Right box. Keep the connection up.
dialogue.vk001_02_velvet_recovery: Copy the prototype and its signing key. Don't change anything on their server yet.
dialogue.vk001_02_v_ledger: Charging extra to leave the loop running.
dialogue.vk001_02_velvet_ledger: They removed the cutoff and put it on a price list. Keep that ledger.
dialogue.vk001_02_v_archive: Your notes. You were trying to stop somebody else's conditioning.
dialogue.vk001_02_velvet_archive: Yeah. Read the deployment instructions. I'll explain when you're clear.
dialogue.vk001_02_velvet_patch: Use the second access point. My build will replace theirs and revoke the stolen batch.
dialogue.vk001_02_velvet_brand: That's the clean build. Keep the link in.
dialogue.vk001_02_velvet_exit: Six seconds without optics for anyone still on their network. Get clear.
dialogue.vk001_02_velvet_retry: Link dropped. That transfer didn't finish. Plug back in when you can.
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_return: Got the key. Their batch's dead. Thanks, V.
dialogue.vk001_03_v_question: That message in the archive. Who was it for?
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_friend: A friend. Her partner bought her a mood regulator. Said she wasn't sleeping. That she worried too much.
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_cost: Whenever she got angry with him, it pushed her back toward feeling good. She'd tell me something he'd done, then start apologising for bringing it up.
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_truth: She knew it was happening. Told me she couldn't stay angry long enough to leave. That's what I built Heartbreaker for.
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_friend_now: She's out. Got her own place. We talk when she wants to.
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_friend_contact: Enough. I don't chase her for an answer.
dialogue.vk001_03_v_sincere: You gave her a chance to get out.
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_sincere: She got herself out. Just needed her head clear long enough. I'm glad I could give her that.
dialogue.vk001_03_v_tease: Still doesn't explain the hearts and ribbons.
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_tease: Those were in my version, too. I'm keeping them.
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_reward: Your build. Heartbreaker Protocol. You'll find it under Velvet Crash. Six-second optics interruption. The Claws' additions are gone.
dialogue.vk001_03_v_reward: Guess I can live with the bows.
dialogue.vk001_03_velvet_close: Give it a try. They look better on someone else's optics.
